meta.status: PLAN for the render PC. Seconds per frame are Episode 1 estimates per set (or the generated set's sheet estimate); the PC measures the real ones (STATUS.txt).
rules: Native 3840x2160, --preset final on every frame. No final-fast, no --twos for masters.
One render.mjs job per shot; chunks of at most ~25 min of one browser.

jobs.basis: ESTIMATE: median of the Episode 1 shots on CLING_SQUARE
jobs.command: node render/render.mjs episodes/t00/final/scenes/cling-square.js --preset final --cinematic velocity --start <shot start, s> --seconds 4.000000 --workers 2 --chunk-seconds 0.2500 --bit-depth 10 --crf 12 --out output/t00/0A/0A-01
